datasets.name: ds_current_status
queryLines:
SELECT
  s.machine_id,
  d.line_name,
  s.state,
  s.last_event_time,
  DATE_TRUNC('HOUR', s.last_event_time) AS last_event_hour,
  s.oee_pct,
  s.anomaly_score,
  s.prob_fault_next_5m,
  s.prob_fault_next_1h,
  s.prob_fault_next_24h,
  s.prob_fault_next_7d,
  s.telemetry_lag_ms,
  s.ml_lag_ms,
  s.temp_c,
  s.vibration_mm_s,
  s.throughput_cpm,
  s.rpm,
  s.current_amps,
  s.humidity_pct,
  s.load_pct,
  s.power_kw,
  s.power_factor,
  s.voltage_v,
  s.pressure_bar,
  s.flow_rate_lpm
FROM
  welch.iot_demo_dev.vw_machine_current_status s
    LEFT JOIN welch.iot_demo_dev.dim_machine d
      ON s.machine_id = d.machine_id

datasets.name: ds_live_telemetry
queryLines:
SELECT
  t.event_time,
  DATE_TRUNC('HOUR', t.event_time) AS event_hour,
  t.machine_id,
  d.line_name,
  t.state,
  t.temp_c,
  t.vibration_mm_s,
  t.rpm,
  t.current_amps,
  t.humidity_pct,
  t.throughput_cpm
FROM
  welch.iot_demo_dev.vw_machine_telemetry_live t
    LEFT JOIN welch.iot_demo_dev.dim_machine d
      ON t.machine_id = d.machine_id

datasets.name: ds_health_window
queryLines:
SELECT
  h.machine_id,
  d.line_name,
  h.window_end,
  DATE_TRUNC('HOUR', h.window_end) AS window_hour,
  h.oee_pct,
  h.availability_pct,
  h.performance_pct,
  h.quality_pct,
  h.time_in_run_s,
  h.time_in_stopped_s,
  h.time_in_fault_s,
  h.anomaly_score,
  h.prob_fault_next_5m,
  h.prob_fault_next_1h,
  h.prob_fault_next_24h,
  h.prob_fault_next_7d
FROM
  welch.iot_demo_dev.vw_machine_health h
    LEFT JOIN welch.iot_demo_dev.dim_machine d
      ON h.machine_id = d.machine_id

datasets.name: ds_device_drilldown
queryLines: SELECT s.machine_id, d.line_name, s.state, s.last_event_time, DATE_TRUNC('HOUR', s.last_event_time) AS last_event_hour, s.telemetry_lag_ms, s.ml_lag_ms, s.temp_c, s.vibration_mm_s, s.throughput_cpm, s.rpm, s.current_amps, s.humidity_pct, s.load_pct, s.power_kw, s.power_factor, s.voltage_v, s.pressure_bar, s.flow_rate_lpm, s.oee_pct, s.anomaly_score, s.prob_fault_next_5m, s.prob_fault_next_1h, s.prob_fault_next_24h, s.prob_fault_next_7d FROM welch.iot_demo_dev.vw_machine_current_status s LEFT JOIN welch.iot_demo_dev.dim_machine d ON s.machine_id = d.machine_id

datasets.name: ds_metric_oee
queryLines: SELECT `Machine` AS machine_id, `Window Hour` AS window_hour, MEASURE(`OEE Pct`) AS oee_pct, MEASURE(`Availability Pct`) AS availability_pct, MEASURE(`Performance Pct`) AS performance_pct, MEASURE(`Quality Pct`) AS quality_pct FROM welch.iot_demo_dev.mv_machine_oee GROUP BY ALL

datasets.name: ds_metric_risk
queryLines: SELECT `Machine` AS machine_id, `Window Date` AS window_date, MEASURE(`Avg Fault Risk 5m`) AS risk_5m, MEASURE(`Avg Fault Risk 1h`) AS risk_1h, MEASURE(`Avg Fault Risk 24h`) AS risk_24h, MEASURE(`Avg Fault Risk 7d`) AS risk_7d, MEASURE(`High Risk Windows`) AS high_risk_windows FROM welch.iot_demo_dev.mv_machine_risk GROUP BY ALL

datasets.name: ds_metric_freshness
queryLines: SELECT `Machine` AS machine_id, MEASURE(`Avg Telemetry Lag Ms`) AS avg_telemetry_lag_ms, MEASURE(`Avg ML Lag Ms`) AS avg_ml_lag_ms, MEASURE(`Max Telemetry Lag Ms`) AS max_telemetry_lag_ms, MEASURE(`Max ML Lag Ms`) AS max_ml_lag_ms FROM welch.iot_demo_dev.mv_machine_freshness GROUP BY ALL

datasets.name: ab2cd493
queryLines:
SELECT
  b.machine_id,
  d.line_name,
  to_timestamp(b.ts) AS device_ts,
  to_timestamp(b.iothub_enqueued_time) AS iothub_ts,
  to_timestamp(b.ingest_ts) AS zerobus_ts,
  b.vibration_mm_s,
  b.temp_c,
  b.throughput_cpm,
  b.rpm,
  b.current_amps,
  b.humidity_pct,
  b.load_pct,
  b.power_kw,
  b.power_factor,
  b.voltage_v,
  b.pressure_bar,
  b.flow_rate_lpm,
  b.state,
  b.fault_code
FROM
  welch.iot_demo_dev.bronze_iot_telemetry b
    LEFT JOIN welch.iot_demo_dev.dim_machine d
      ON b.machine_id = d.machine_id
WHERE
  b.ts IS NOT NULL
  AND b.iothub_enqueued_time IS NOT NULL
  AND b.ingest_ts IS NOT NULL

columns.description: Latency from source device to Azure IoT Hub in milliseconds
Latency from Azure IoT Hub to ZeroBus ingestion in milliseconds
End-to-end latency from device to ZeroBus in milliseconds
Categorizes total latency into buckets for distribution analysis
columns.expression: CASE WHEN (unix_millis(`zerobus_ts`) - unix_millis(`device_ts`)) < 500 THEN '< 500ms' WHEN (unix_millis(`zerobus_ts`) - unix_millis(`device_ts`)) < 1000 THEN '500ms - 1s' WHEN (unix_millis(`zerobus_ts`) - unix_millis(`device_ts`)) < 5000 THEN '1s - 5s' WHEN (unix_millis(`zerobus_ts`) - unix_millis(`device_ts`)) < 60000 THEN '5s - 1m' ELSE '> 1m (Outlier)' END

columns.description: Flags records with total latency > 5s as outliers (well above p50 of 586ms)
columns.expression: CASE WHEN (unix_millis(`zerobus_ts`) - unix_millis(`device_ts`)) > 5000 THEN 'Outlier' ELSE 'Normal' END

datasets.name: 8e3ad484
queryLines:
SELECT
  b.machine_id,
  d.line_name,
  to_timestamp(b.ts) AS event_time,
  to_timestamp(b.iothub_enqueued_time) AS iothub_time,
  to_timestamp(b.ingest_ts) AS ingest_time,
  b.state,
  b.fault_code,
  b.temp_c,
  b.vibration_mm_s,
  b.rpm,
  b.current_amps,
  b.humidity_pct,
  b.load_pct,
  b.power_kw,
  b.power_factor,
  b.voltage_v,
  b.pressure_bar,
  b.flow_rate_lpm,
  b.throughput_cpm
FROM
  welch.iot_demo_dev.bronze_iot_telemetry b
    LEFT JOIN welch.iot_demo_dev.dim_machine d
      ON b.machine_id = d.machine_id
WHERE
  b.ts IS NOT NULL
QUALIFY
  ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY b.machine_id ORDER BY b.ts DESC) = 1
